about: Deferred asks (governance/backlog.py, doc 103): anything the owner asked for that was not finished in the session that heard it, in our own words, with a due date and the next step. A session can end at any time; this file is in git, so the next session, the weekly backlog issue and ./securax backlog all see it. Close an item by setting state to done and naming where it was finished. Never put personal data, employer or bank names, or pasted document text here: the repository is public.
